title: Amethyst Golem
description: Transforms your golem into an amethyst one.
body:
🔮 The resource pack replaces the usual golem with an amethyst one! 🔮

🧱 **Preview** 🧱 ![♥ The Iron Golems send their greetings! ♥](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e5a14b2aaee52b037dd1c3a8b9a4043b1212a70.jpeg) ✨ **Description** ✨ > Transforms your golem into an amethyst one!
⚠️ Requirements
  • The resource pack does not require any modifications at all and works in vanilla Minecraft.
  • ❌ ATTENTION ❌
    • DO NOT combine this resource pack with other resource packs changing the golem model , this can lead to visual (and not only) bugs, before using another resource pack on the Iron Golem, make sure that this resource pack is disabled (in the settings)!
🛠️ Installation Guide
  1. Download the file of the version you need
  2. WITHOUT unzipping, move the file to the "Resourcepacks" folder
  3. Enable resource pack
  4. Done, you can safely enjoy yourself!
📦 Versions
  • Resourcepack works on versions from 1.16.5 to 26.1
  • As for other versions - there may be bugs, you can report them to this email address (feedback) - kaktusvochkah@gmail.com
✉️ Feedback contacts You can report bugs and suggest ideas by e-mail kaktusvochkah@gmail.com
